verdict.rationale: Granola documents a CSV export of meeting notes (titles, summaries, transcripts) explicitly framed for backups, migration, and GDPR data portability, plus an API for programmatic access to notes/transcripts — giving genuine open-format export of core meeting data. However, this only covers notes/transcripts, not a full account/data export (e.g., calendar links, folder structure, settings, audio) and there's no documented single-click 'export everything and delete account' flow.  missing for 10: full account-data export beyond notes/transcripts, independent confirmation of export completeness, and an explicit account-deletion/data-portability workflow.
